releases.body:
Multiple todos can now be active at once, configurable two ways:

- the `allowMultipleActive` option (default `false`) keeps every `in_progress` item instead of demoting the extras to `pending`;
- the new `todo_settings` tool reads/changes a per-session override (`true`, `false` or `null` to clear), persisted in storage so it survives a restart.

`todo_add` also keeps the "one active task" invariant now (it used to allow two), `todo_read` reports the active mode, and the injected context block tells the model when several items may be in progress.

The todo popover now opens centered and with a proper default size.

The host's dialog.show() resets the presentation (it sets centered back to false, which anchors the card a quarter of the way down), so the options are applied after show() and re-asserted on mount. The first press of f used to be what applied centering, which is why it looked like it only moved the dialog before resizing it; f now only cycles the width.

The list body also fills at least 60% of its budget, so a short list renders as a proper panel instead of a sliver.

Gate todo keys per command rather than per layer. The host drops a layer-level `enabled`, so the previous fix had no effect and a focused docked panel kept swallowing the model picker/palette/completion arrow keys. Each command now checks the live keymap mode at dispatch and yields (falls through) when an overlay is up.

The todo keymap layer now yields the arrow keys to overlays. Its layer binds up/down globally at a high priority, so a focused docked side panel was shadowing the model picker (and palette/completions). The panel layer is now live only while focused and no overlay mode is active; the popover keeps the keyboard inside its own dialog.

Fixes the todo popover overflowing the bottom of the screen: the popover now lays out to the host dialog card width (medium 60 / large 88 / xlarge 116 cells) instead of a share of the terminal, and renders with wrapping off, so rows never wrap and the content-hugging card cannot grow past the screen. The popover now opens at the xlarge preset.
